import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Fix island label variant (dream -> Dream)
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'dream': 'Dream'})
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to number (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Fix negative flipper_length_mm (convert -226 to positive, assuming typo)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    
    # Ensure flipper_length_mm is within valid range [170, 235]
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    
    # Ensure species values are valid
    valid_species = ['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo']
    df.loc[~df['species'].isin(valid_species), 'species'] = pd.NA
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and compute average flipper length
    result = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().dropna().to_dict()
    return result
